title: Heartbeat Audit Record
description: One admin or operator change (ADR 0016): the body of an OTLP log record with service.name heartbeat-api and event.name heartbeat.audit. Secrets never appear in it: before and after hold credential references, never passwords, password hashes, session IDs or tokens.

id.description: Unique per record; a record delivered twice has the same id (also the log record's log.record.uid attribute).

time.description: When the change was made, in UTC.

request_id.description: The request, or the command run, that made the change.

actor.description: Who made the change: a logged-in user, an administrative command run in an API container, the API itself running a task of its own, or a client that is not logged in, such as one whose login failed.

host.description: The host the command ran on: the pod's name.

command.description: The task the API ran, such as the probe assignment applied check.

host.description: The host the API ran on: the pod's name.

address.description: The client's IP address, behind trusted proxies the one they forwarded.

action.description: What was done, such as create, login, logout or login_failed.

entity_type.description: What the change is about, such as user or session.

before.description: The entity before the change; null when it was created.

after.description: The entity after the change; null when it was deleted.

config_version.description: The runtime config version the change concerns, when it concerns runtime config.
